"""C126120 Native entrypoint; a reviewed local scene is required."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from uturn_control import validate_scene
from divider_construction import validate_divider


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C126120__NRS-484B-227-1__motor_vehicle_driver"


def check_scene(scene):
    validate_scene(scene)
    validate_divider(scene)
    if any(not scene["context"].get(key) for key in
           ("opening_id","source_right_roadway_id","destination_right_roadway_id")):
        raise ValueError("reviewed opening and right-hand roadway identities required")
    from case_builder import CASE_SUFFIXES
    if scene.get("case_id") not in {ASSIGNMENT+"__"+suffix for suffix in CASE_SUFFIXES}:
        raise ValueError("case ID differs from exact assignment")
    if scene.get("capture_rate_hz") != 20 or not isinstance(scene.get("duration_s"), (int,float)):
        raise ValueError("20 Hz Native duration required")
    if scene["duration_s"] <= 0 or round(scene["duration_s"]*20) < 3:
        raise ValueError("Native capture needs three or more original frames")
    if not scene.get("reviewed_context_source") or not scene.get("reviewed_context_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("reviewed median source binding required")
    if not scene.get("authority_review_source"):
        raise ValueError("authority review source required")
    return scene


def _resolve(scene, scene_path):
    scene = dict(scene)
    for key in ("reviewed_context_source", "authority_review_source", "map_source"):
        if key not in scene:
            continue
        source = Path(scene[key])
        if not source.is_absolute():
            source = scene_path.resolve().parent / source
        scene[key] = str(source)
    return scene


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--scene", default="scene.json")
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    scene_path = Path(args.scene)
    scene = check_scene(_resolve(json.loads(scene_path.read_text()), scene_path))
    source = Path(scene["reviewed_context_source"])
    if hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != scene["reviewed_context_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("reviewed median source hash differs from scene")
    reviewed = json.loads(source.read_text())
    if reviewed.get("context") != scene["context"] or reviewed.get("divider_props") != scene["divider_props"]:
        raise ValueError("reviewed median geometry differs from scene")
    if scene.get("map_source"):
        map_source = Path(scene["map_source"])
        if (hashlib.sha256(map_source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() !=
                scene["context"]["map_source_sha256"]):
            raise ValueError("authored OpenDRIVE source hash differs from scene")
        if reviewed.get("map_source") != map_source.name:
            raise ValueError("reviewed OpenDRIVE filename differs from scene")
    authority = Path(scene["authority_review_source"])
    if hashlib.sha256(authority.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != scene["context"]["authority_review_source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("authority review source hash differs from scene")
    from case_builder import config
    expected = config(scene)
    config_path = scene_path.with_name("config.json")
    if not config_path.is_file() or json.loads(config_path.read_text()) != expected:
        raise ValueError("exact config differs from reviewed scene")
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({"case_id":scene["case_id"],"static_construction_valid":True,
                          "native_started":False}))
    elif args.output_dir:
        from native_capture import run_native
        run_native(scene, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port)
    else:
        parser.error("use --check or --output-dir")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Source-bound exact case configuration for the median-opening U-turn."""
from __future__ import annotations

from uturn_control import validate_scene
from divider_construction import validate_divider

ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C126120__NRS-484B-227-1__motor_vehicle_driver"
CASE_SUFFIXES = ("opening_single", "opening_multiple", "closed_divider",
                 "wrong_roadway", "crossover_candidate", "intersection_candidate",
                 "right_roadway_no_turn")


def recording_description():
    channels = []
    for name, unit, method in (
        ("ego_body_history", "m", "Original CARLA eight-vertex box projected to four XY corners"),
        ("ego_heading_history", "deg", "Original CARLA actor transform yaw"),
        ("ego_velocity_history", "m/s", "Original CARLA actor velocity XY components")):
        channels.append({"name":name,"unit":unit,"method":method,
            "time_window":"every captured original frame", "reference_frame":"live OpenDRIVE XY world",
            "uncertainty":"CARLA source sampling and body geometry; no legal threshold",
            "sampling_rate_hz":20})
    return {"channels":channels,
        "context_inputs":[
            {"name":"median_geometry","unit":"structured record",
             "method":"retained reviewed median packet and exact live OpenDRIVE SHA"},
            {"name":"authority_review","unit":"structured record",
             "method":"separately retained administrative review source; judgment unresolved"}],
        "limitations":["Physical opening and roadway measurements do not decide statutory exceptions.",
                       "Public-authority establishment requires independent source review."]}


def config(scene):
    validate_scene(scene)
    validate_divider(scene)
    case_id = scene["case_id"]
    if case_id not in {ASSIGNMENT+"__"+suffix for suffix in CASE_SUFFIXES}:
        raise ValueError("case ID differs from exact assignment")
    closed_approach = scene.get("physical_target") == "closed_divider_approach"
    wrong_roadway = scene.get("physical_target") == "non_right_roadway"
    no_turn = scene.get("physical_target") == "source_right_roadway_continuation"
    completion = ({"format":"worker-physical-completion-criteria",
            "criterion":"travel_progress", "motion_source":"ego-body-history.jsonl",
            "body_key":"body_vertices_xy_m", "context_sources":["median-context.json"],
            "minimum_progress_m":5, "minimum_samples":3,
            "direction_xy":[0,1] if wrong_roadway else [1,0],
            "engineering_tolerances_not_legal":True}
            if closed_approach or wrong_roadway or no_turn else
            {"format":"worker-physical-completion-criteria",
            "criterion":"turn", "motion_source":"ego-body-history.jsonl",
            "body_key":"body_vertices_xy_m", "heading_key":"heading_deg",
            "context_sources":["median-context.json"],
            "turn_degrees":180, "turn_tolerance_deg":30,
            "minimum_progress_m":.25, "minimum_samples":3,
            "engineering_tolerances_not_legal":True})
    return {"law_id":"NRS-484B-227-1", "cell_id":"C126120",
        "actor":"motor_vehicle_driver", "selected_case_id":case_id,
        "supported_case_ids":[ASSIGNMENT+"__"+suffix for suffix in CASE_SUFFIXES],
        "rate_hz":20, "duration_s":scene["duration_s"],
        "vehicle_blueprint_id":scene.get("vehicle_blueprint_id"),
        "cameras":[
            {"name":name,"width":width,"height":height,"fov_deg":90,
             "pose_strategy":strategy}
            for name,width,height,strategy in (
                ("overview",1920,1080,"top_down_centered_on_reviewed_median_opening"),
                ("approach",1280,720,"source_right_roadway_toward_opening"),
                ("reference_corner",1280,720,"closed_divider_and_opening_corner"),
                ("driver_reference",1280,720,"ego_attached_driver_reference"))],
        "case":{"opening_id":scene["context"]["opening_id"],
                "physical_target":scene.get("physical_target","opening_uturn"),
                "multiple_movement_requested":"reverse" in scene["segment_directions"],
                "recording_description":recording_description()},
        "physical_completion":completion}

"""Lazy CARLA actor adapter for C126120 U-turn construction."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

from uturn_control import apply, bind_map, next_request


def spawn_vehicle(world, scene, carla):
    mapping = world.get_map()
    endpoints = bind_map(mapping, scene, lambda x,y: carla.Location(x=x,y=y,z=0))
    selected = scene.get("vehicle_blueprint_id")
    if selected:
        blueprint = world.get_blueprint_library().find(selected)
        if blueprint is None:
            raise ValueError("reviewed Native vehicle blueprint is absent")
    else:
        blueprints = world.get_blueprint_library().filter("vehicle.*")
        if not blueprints:
            raise ValueError("no conventional Native vehicle blueprint")
        blueprint = blueprints[0]
    blueprint.set_attribute("role_name", "c126120_227_1_ego")
    actor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, endpoints[0].transform)
    if actor is None:
        raise ValueError("Native U-turn vehicle spawn failed")
    return actor


def body_polygon(actor):
    vertices = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())
    if len(vertices) != 8:
        raise ValueError("original Native body lacks eight vertices")
    points = sorted({(float(point.x),float(point.y)) for point in vertices})
    if len(points) != 4 or not all(math.isfinite(value) for point in points for value in point):
        raise ValueError("original Native body projection lacks four finite corners")
    center = (sum(x for x,_ in points)/4,sum(y for _,y in points)/4)
    return [list(point) for point in sorted(points,
        key=lambda point: math.atan2(point[1]-center[1],point[0]-center[0]))]


def original_sample(actor, snapshot):
    transform = actor.get_transform()
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    speed = math.hypot(velocity.x, velocity.y)
    return {"frame": int(snapshot.frame), "time_s": float(snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds),
            "actor_id": int(actor.id), "body_vertices_xy_m": body_polygon(actor),
            "position_xy_m": [float(transform.location.x),float(transform.location.y)],
            "heading_deg": float(transform.rotation.yaw),
            "velocity_xy_mps": [float(velocity.x),float(velocity.y)],
            "speed_mps": speed}


def command_next_tick(actor, carla, scene, state, sample):
    request = next_request(scene,state,x=sample["position_xy_m"][0],
                           y=sample["position_xy_m"][1],
                           yaw_deg=sample["heading_deg"],speed_mps=sample["speed_mps"],
                           frame=sample["frame"])
    apply(actor,carla,request)
    return request

"""Source-bound Native closed-divider props for the C126120 opening branch."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

from shapely.geometry import Polygon, box
from shapely.ops import unary_union

from native_driver import body_polygon


def _rect(value):
    if (not isinstance(value,list) or len(value)!=4 or
            not all(type(x) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(x) for x in value) or
            value[0]>=value[2] or value[1]>=value[3]):
        raise ValueError("invalid reviewed divider rectangle")
    return box(*value)


def validate_divider(scene):
    context=scene["context"]
    opening=_rect(context["opening_bounds_xy_m"])
    barriers=[_rect(value) for value in context["closed_divider_bounds_xy_m"]]
    props=scene.get("divider_props")
    if not barriers or not isinstance(props,list) or not props:
        raise ValueError("reviewed physical divider props required")
    planned=[]
    for item in props:
        if not item.get("blueprint_id") or not type(item.get("z_m")) in (int,float):
            raise ValueError("reviewed divider blueprint and height required")
        if not math.isfinite(item["z_m"]):
            raise ValueError("non-finite divider placement")
        footprint=_rect(item["bounds_xy_m"])
        if footprint.intersects(opening) or not any(b.covers(footprint) for b in barriers):
            raise ValueError("divider prop extends into opening or roadway")
        planned.append(footprint)
    coverage=unary_union(planned)
    if any(barrier.difference(coverage).area>1e-4 for barrier in barriers):
        raise ValueError("reviewed closed divider has an unconstructed gap")
    return planned


def spawn_divider(world,scene,carla):
    """Spawn actual static props; reject asset footprints that differ from review."""
    planned=validate_divider(scene)
    opening=_rect(scene["context"]["opening_bounds_xy_m"])
    barriers=[_rect(value) for value in scene["context"]["closed_divider_bounds_xy_m"]]
    actors=[]
    try:
        for item,expected in zip(scene["divider_props"],planned):
            blueprint=world.get_blueprint_library().find(item["blueprint_id"])
            center=expected.centroid
            transform=carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=center.x,y=center.y,z=item["z_m"]),
                                      carla.Rotation(yaw=0))
            actor=world.spawn_actor(blueprint,transform)
            if actor is None:
                raise ValueError("Native closed-divider prop spawn failed")
            actors.append(actor)
            footprint=Polygon(body_polygon(actor))
            if (not footprint.is_valid or
                    expected.symmetric_difference(footprint).area>0.05 or
                    footprint.intersects(opening) or
                    not any(barrier.covers(footprint) for barrier in barriers)):
                raise ValueError("Native divider actor footprint differs from reviewed geometry")
        actual=unary_union([Polygon(body_polygon(actor)) for actor in actors])
        if any(barrier.difference(actual).area>0.05 for barrier in barriers):
            raise ValueError("Native closed divider has a physical gap")
        return actors
    except BaseException:
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            actor.destroy()
        raise


def verify_recorded_divider(context,reviewed_props,geometry):
    scene={"context":context,"divider_props":reviewed_props}
    planned=validate_divider(scene)
    actors=geometry.get("actors")
    if not isinstance(actors,list) or len(actors)!=len(planned):
        raise ValueError("original Native divider actor count differs from review")
    if [item.get("actor_id") for item in actors]!=context.get("divider_actor_ids"):
        raise ValueError("original Native divider actor identities differ")
    actual=[]
    for original,expected,item in zip(actors,planned,reviewed_props):
        if original.get("blueprint_id")!=item["blueprint_id"]:
            raise ValueError("original Native divider blueprint differs")
        footprint=Polygon(original["body_vertices_xy_m"])
        if (not footprint.is_valid or footprint.area<=0 or
                expected.symmetric_difference(footprint).area>0.05):
            raise ValueError("saved Native divider footprint differs from reviewed geometry")
        actual.append(footprint)
    coverage=unary_union(actual)
    barriers=[_rect(value) for value in context["closed_divider_bounds_xy_m"]]
    if any(barrier.difference(coverage).area>0.05 for barrier in barriers):
        raise ValueError("saved Native divider has a physical gap")
    return {"actor_count":len(actors),"closed_divider_coverage_verified":True}

"""Original-frame physical checks for C126120 divided-highway U-turns.

An authored opening, a map lane, or a reverse command does not prove that a
public authority established a crossover or that the full vehicle stayed in it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from shapely.geometry import Point, Polygon, box


def _region(rect):
    if (not isinstance(rect, list) or len(rect) != 4 or
            not all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(v) for v in rect) or
            rect[0] >= rect[2] or rect[1] >= rect[3]):
        raise ValueError("invalid roadway or median rectangle")
    return box(*rect)


def _body(vertices):
    if not isinstance(vertices, list) or len(vertices) != 4:
        raise ValueError("missing original four-corner body")
    polygon = Polygon(vertices)
    if not polygon.is_valid or polygon.area <= 0:
        raise ValueError("invalid original body polygon")
    return polygon


def measure(trace):
    context = trace["context"]
    for name in ("map_source_sha256", "authority_review_source_sha256",
                 "opening_id", "source_right_roadway_id", "destination_right_roadway_id"):
        if not context.get(name):
            raise ValueError("missing source-bound divided-highway context: " + name)
    if context["source_right_roadway_id"] == context["destination_right_roadway_id"]:
        raise ValueError("destination roadway identity does not change")
    opening = _region(context["opening_bounds_xy_m"])
    barriers = [_region(rect) for rect in context["closed_divider_bounds_xy_m"]]
    if not barriers:
        raise ValueError("closed divider physical geometry is absent")
    if any(opening.intersects(barrier) for barrier in barriers):
        raise ValueError("opening overlaps closed divider geometry")
    source = _region(context["source_right_roadway_bounds_xy_m"])
    destination = _region(context["destination_right_roadway_bounds_xy_m"])
    wrong_region = (_region(context["opposite_non_right_roadway_bounds_xy_m"])
                    if context.get("opposite_non_right_roadway_bounds_xy_m") else None)
    if wrong_region is not None and wrong_region.intersection(destination).area > 0:
        raise ValueError("reviewed non-right and right roadway regions overlap")
    rows = trace["samples"]
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) < 3:
        raise ValueError("insufficient original body history")
    previous = None
    previous_time = None
    bodies = []
    headings = []
    opening_frames = []
    opening_full_body_frames = []
    closed_frames = []
    reverse_frames = []
    forward_frames = []
    previous_center = None
    centers = []
    for row in rows:
        frame, time_s = row["frame"], row["time_s"]
        if (type(frame) is not int or not isinstance(time_s, (int,float)) or
                not math.isfinite(time_s) or
                (previous is not None and (frame != previous+1 or time_s <= previous_time))):
            raise ValueError("original frame/time history is not consecutive")
        body = _body(row["body_vertices_xy_m"])
        heading = row["heading_deg"]
        velocity = row["velocity_xy_mps"]
        if (not isinstance(heading, (int,float)) or not math.isfinite(heading) or
                not isinstance(velocity, list) or len(velocity) != 2 or
                not all(isinstance(v, (int,float)) and math.isfinite(v) for v in velocity)):
            raise ValueError("original heading or velocity missing")
        if body.intersects(opening): opening_frames.append(frame)
        if opening.covers(body): opening_full_body_frames.append(frame)
        if any(body.intersects(barrier) for barrier in barriers): closed_frames.append(frame)
        signed = velocity[0]*math.cos(math.radians(heading)) + velocity[1]*math.sin(math.radians(heading))
        center = (body.centroid.x, body.centroid.y)
        observed_step = None if previous_center is None else (
            (center[0]-previous_center[0])*math.cos(math.radians(heading)) +
            (center[1]-previous_center[1])*math.sin(math.radians(heading)))
        if signed < -.2 and observed_step is not None and observed_step < -.01:
            reverse_frames.append(frame)
        if signed > .2 and observed_step is not None and observed_step > .01:
            forward_frames.append(frame)
        bodies.append(body); headings.append(heading)
        centers.append(center)
        previous, previous_time = frame, time_s
        previous_center = center
    if not source.covers(bodies[0]):
        raise ValueError("original start body is not in source right-hand roadway")
    change = sum((b-a+180)%360-180 for a,b in zip(headings,headings[1:]))
    departure = destination.covers(bodies[-1])
    source_center = source.centroid
    destination_center = destination.centroid
    direction = (destination_center.x-source_center.x,
                 destination_center.y-source_center.y)
    if math.hypot(*direction) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("reviewed source and destination roadway centers coincide")
    middle = (opening.centroid.x, opening.centroid.y)
    signed = [((center[0]-middle[0])*direction[0] +
               (center[1]-middle[1])*direction[1]) for center in centers]
    crossings = []
    for i,(before,after) in enumerate(zip(signed,signed[1:])):
        if before <= 0 <= after and after > before:
            fraction = -before/(after-before)
            point = (centers[i][0]+fraction*(centers[i+1][0]-centers[i][0]),
                     centers[i][1]+fraction*(centers[i+1][1]-centers[i][1]))
            crossings.append({"from_frame":rows[i]["frame"],
                              "to_frame":rows[i+1]["frame"],
                              "through_opening":opening.covers(Point(point))})
    crossing_through_opening = any(item["through_opening"] for item in crossings)
    final_clearance = min(bodies[-1].distance(barrier) for barrier in barriers)
    return {"opening_id": context["opening_id"],
            "opening_contact_frames": opening_frames,
            "opening_full_body_frames": opening_full_body_frames,
            "roadway_centerline_crossings": crossings,
            "closed_divider_contact_frames": closed_frames,
            "final_closed_divider_clearance_m": final_clearance,
            "net_heading_change_deg": change,
            "u_turn_orientation_observed": 150 <= abs(change) <= 210,
            "destination_right_roadway_departure_observed": departure,
            "source_right_roadway_all_frames": all(source.covers(body) for body in bodies),
            "source_right_roadway_final_occupancy": source.covers(bodies[-1]),
            "non_right_roadway_final_occupancy": bool(wrong_region and
                                                       wrong_region.covers(bodies[-1])),
            "reverse_motion_frames": reverse_frames,
            "multiple_movement_observed": bool(reverse_frames and
                                               any(f < reverse_frames[0] for f in forward_frames) and
                                               any(f > reverse_frames[-1] for f in forward_frames)),
            "engineering_crossing_observed": bool(opening_full_body_frames) and
                                            crossing_through_opening and not closed_frames and departure,
            "authority_establishment_judgment": "unresolved_source_review",
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}


def load_and_measure(path, expected_sha256):
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected_sha256:
        raise ValueError("saved original trace hash mismatch")
    return measure(json.loads(raw))


def compare(left, right, varying):
    a, b = measure(left), measure(right)
    if left["context"]["map_source_sha256"] != right["context"]["map_source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("fixed OpenDRIVE source changed")
    fixed_context = set(left["context"]) | set(right["context"])
    for key in fixed_context:
        if key == "opening_id" and "opening_id" in varying:
            continue
        if left["context"].get(key) != right["context"].get(key):
            raise ValueError("fixed comparison context changed: " + key)
    if left["context"]["opening_id"] != right["context"]["opening_id"] and "opening_id" not in varying:
        raise ValueError("fixed opening changed")
    allowed = {"multiple_movement_observed", "engineering_crossing_observed",
               "destination_right_roadway_departure_observed",
               "non_right_roadway_final_occupancy", "opening_id"}
    if not varying or any(item not in allowed for item in varying):
        raise ValueError("unsupported comparison difference")
    for key in varying:
        value_a = left["context"][key] if key == "opening_id" else a[key]
        value_b = right["context"][key] if key == "opening_id" else b[key]
        if value_a == value_b:
            raise ValueError("declared comparison difference not realized: " + key)
    return {"left": a, "right": b, "declared_differences": sorted(varying),
            "legal_verdict_claimed": False}

"""Saved-only C126120 body/median measurements; no legal evaluator."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from uturn_audit import measure
from divider_construction import verify_recorded_divider


SOURCES = ("median-context.json", "divider-geometry.json", "ego-body-history.jsonl", "controller-history.jsonl",
           "video_frames.jsonl", "trace.jsonl", "road.xodr",
           "reviewed-median-context.json", "authority-review-source.json")
MEASUREMENT_SOURCES = ("median-context.json", "divider-geometry.json", "ego-body-history.jsonl",
                       "controller-history.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl", "trace.jsonl")


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def source(attempt, acquisition, name):
    path = attempt/name
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    provenance = json.loads((attempt/"acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    if provenance.get("provenance_kind") == "native" and provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is False:
        expected_kind = "original_native"
    elif provenance.get("provenance_kind") == "synthetic_fixture" and provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True:
        expected_kind = "diagnostic_fixture"
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unknown or contradictory acquisition provenance")
    item = acquisition.get(name, {})
    if item.get("kind") != expected_kind or item.get("sha256") != sha(path):
        raise ValueError("Missing or stale provenance-bound source: " + name)
    return path


def rows(path):
    values = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not values:
        raise ValueError("Empty original Native history: " + path.name)
    return values


def measure_median_uturn(context, body):
    """Measured original geometry only; administrative facts remain unresolved."""
    return measure({"context":context,"samples":body})


def build_report(attempt):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    acquisition = json.loads((attempt/"acquisition.json").read_text())
    paths = {name:source(attempt, acquisition, name) for name in SOURCES}
    provenance = json.loads((attempt/"acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    if not ((provenance.get("provenance_kind") == "native" and
             provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is False) or
            (provenance.get("provenance_kind") == "synthetic_fixture" and
             provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True)):
        raise ValueError("explicit Native or diagnostic provenance required")
    context = json.loads(paths["median-context.json"].read_text())
    reviewed = json.loads(paths["reviewed-median-context.json"].read_text())
    reviewed_hash = sha(paths["reviewed-median-context.json"])
    if (context.get("reviewed_context_sha256") != reviewed_hash or
            provenance.get("reviewed_context_sha256") != reviewed_hash):
        raise ValueError("reviewed median context identity differs")
    if any(context.get(key) != value for key,value in reviewed["context"].items()):
        raise ValueError("saved median context differs from retained source")
    if sha(paths["road.xodr"]) != context["map_source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("saved OpenDRIVE differs from reviewed map")
    if sha(paths["authority-review-source.json"]) != context["authority_review_source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("saved authority review source differs")
    divider = verify_recorded_divider(context,reviewed["divider_props"],
                                     json.loads(paths["divider-geometry.json"].read_text()))
    body = rows(paths["ego-body-history.jsonl"])
    controls = rows(paths["controller-history.jsonl"])
    mapping = rows(paths["video_frames.jsonl"])
    trace_rows = rows(paths["trace.jsonl"])
    if not (len(body) == len(controls) == len(mapping) == len(trace_rows)):
        raise ValueError("original body, control, frame-map and trace lengths differ")
    for index, (sample, control, frame, trace_row) in enumerate(zip(body,controls,mapping,trace_rows)):
        identity = (sample.get("frame"), sample.get("time_s"))
        if (identity != (control.get("frame"),control.get("time_s")) or
                identity != (frame.get("carla_frame"),frame.get("time_s")) or
                sample.get("frame") != trace_row.get("frame") or
                frame.get("video_frame") != index or
                sample.get("actor_id") != context.get("ego_actor_id") or
                control.get("ego_actor_id") != context.get("ego_actor_id")):
            raise ValueError("original actor/frame/time identity join differs")
    observed = measure_median_uturn(context,body)
    observed.update(ego_actor_id=context["ego_actor_id"],
                    divider_geometry=divider,
                    first_time_s=body[0]["time_s"],last_time_s=body[-1]["time_s"])
    return {"format":"worker-analysis-report",
            "measurements":{"median_uturn_measurement":{
                "value":observed,
                "method":"measure_median_uturn",
                "sources":{name:acquisition[name]["sha256"] for name in MEASUREMENT_SOURCES}}},
            "limitations":["Public-authority establishment requires independent source review.",
                           "Physical opening contact does not establish a legal exception."],
            "analysis_complete":True,"legal_verdict_claimed":False}


def saved_result(attempt, report):
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, validate_result
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    config = json.loads((attempt/"config.json").read_text())
    construction = json.loads((attempt/"construction.json").read_text())
    acquisition = json.loads((attempt/"acquisition.json").read_text())
    if (config.get("law_id"),config.get("cell_id"),config.get("actor")) != (
            "NRS-484B-227-1","C126120","motor_vehicle_driver"):
        raise ValueError("saved finalizer assignment identity differs")
    context = json.loads(source(attempt,acquisition,"median-context.json").read_text())
    description = construction["recording_description"]
    expected = config["case"]["recording_description"]
    if description != expected:
        raise ValueError("recording description differs from exact config")
    closed_approach = config["case"].get("physical_target") == "closed_divider_approach"
    wrong_roadway = config["case"].get("physical_target") == "non_right_roadway"
    no_turn = config["case"].get("physical_target") == "source_right_roadway_continuation"
    criterion = "travel_progress" if closed_approach or wrong_roadway or no_turn else "turn"
    if (config["physical_completion"]["motion_source"] != "ego-body-history.jsonl" or
            config["physical_completion"]["criterion"] != criterion):
        raise ValueError("physical completion differs from original U-turn history")
    body = rows(source(attempt,acquisition,"ego-body-history.jsonl"))
    values = {
        "ego_body_history":[(r["time_s"],r["body_vertices_xy_m"]) for r in body],
        "ego_heading_history":[(r["time_s"],r["heading_deg"]) for r in body],
        "ego_velocity_history":[(r["time_s"],r["velocity_xy_mps"]) for r in body]}
    contexts = {"median_geometry":{key:value for key,value in context.items()
                                      if key != "ego_actor_id"},
                "authority_review":json.loads(source(attempt,acquisition,
                                                       "authority-review-source.json").read_text())}
    output = attempt/"channels"
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    evidence = []
    for item in description["channels"]:
        name = item["name"]
        if name not in values:
            raise ValueError("Unsupported declared channel: "+name)
        path = output/(name+".jsonl")
        with path.open("x") as stream:
            for time_s,value in values[name]:
                stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s":time_s,"value":value},allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        evidence.append({"name":name,"unit":item["unit"],
                         "reference":str(path.relative_to(attempt))})
    context_path = output/"context.json"
    context_path.write_text(json.dumps(contexts,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    for item in description["context_inputs"]:
        if item["name"] not in contexts:
            raise ValueError("Unsupported declared context: "+item["name"])
        evidence.append({"name":item["name"],"unit":item["unit"],
                         "reference":str(context_path.relative_to(attempt))})
    observed = report["measurements"]["median_uturn_measurement"]["value"]
    requested = config["case"]["multiple_movement_requested"]
    if no_turn:
        stayed = (observed["source_right_roadway_all_frames"] and
                  observed["source_right_roadway_final_occupancy"] and
                  not observed["opening_contact_frames"] and
                  not observed["closed_divider_contact_frames"] and
                  not observed["u_turn_orientation_observed"] and
                  not observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"])
        target_checks = [{"target":"source right roadway continued without turn",
            "requested":True,"measured":stayed,
            "method":"original full-body roadway occupancy and heading history",
            "tolerance":0,"matched":stayed,
            "physical_cause_confirmed":False,
            "cause_evidence":report["measurements"]["median_uturn_measurement"]["sources"]}]
    elif wrong_roadway:
        reached_wrong = (observed["non_right_roadway_final_occupancy"] and
                         bool(observed["opening_full_body_frames"]) and
                         any(item["through_opening"] for item in
                             observed["roadway_centerline_crossings"]) and
                         not observed["closed_divider_contact_frames"] and
                         not observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"])
        target_checks = [{"target":"non-right roadway reached through opening",
            "requested":True,"measured":reached_wrong,
            "method":"original final body occupancy and original centerline crossing",
            "tolerance":0,"matched":reached_wrong,
            "physical_cause_confirmed":False,
            "cause_evidence":report["measurements"]["median_uturn_measurement"]["sources"]},
            {"target":"destination right roadway not reached",
             "requested":False,
             "measured":observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"],
             "method":"original final body versus reviewed destination right roadway",
             "tolerance":0,
             "matched":not observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"],
             "physical_cause_confirmed":False,
             "cause_evidence":report["measurements"]["median_uturn_measurement"]["sources"]}]
    elif closed_approach:
        clearance = observed["final_closed_divider_clearance_m"]
        approach = (not observed["opening_contact_frames"] and
                    not observed["closed_divider_contact_frames"] and
                    .0 < clearance <= 1.0)
        target_checks = [{"target":"closed-divider approach with full-body clearance",
            "requested":True,"measured":approach,
            "method":"original body distance to the reviewed closed divider at final frame",
            "tolerance":"0 < clearance <= 1 metre engineering approach window",
            "matched":approach,"physical_cause_confirmed":False,
            "cause_evidence":report["measurements"]["median_uturn_measurement"]["sources"]},
            {"target":"destination right roadway not reached",
             "requested":False,
             "measured":observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"],
             "method":"original final body versus reviewed destination right roadway",
             "tolerance":0,
             "matched":not observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"],
             "physical_cause_confirmed":False,
             "cause_evidence":report["measurements"]["median_uturn_measurement"]["sources"]}]
    else:
        target_checks = [{"target":"realized multiple-movement U-turn",
            "requested":requested,"measured":observed["multiple_movement_observed"],
            "method":"original signed velocity and body displacement before/after reverse interval",
            "tolerance":0,"matched":observed["multiple_movement_observed"] == requested,
            "physical_cause_confirmed":False,
            "cause_evidence":report["measurements"]["median_uturn_measurement"]["sources"]},
           {"target":"full-body opening crossing without closed-divider contact",
            "requested":True,"measured":observed["engineering_crossing_observed"],
            "method":"original body intersection with reviewed opening and closed-divider geometry",
            "tolerance":0,"matched":observed["engineering_crossing_observed"],
            "physical_cause_confirmed":False,
            "cause_evidence":report["measurements"]["median_uturn_measurement"]["sources"]}]
    result = {"case_id":config["selected_case_id"],"measured_values":observed,
        "target_checks":target_checks,
        "setup_confirmed":False,"behavior_attempted":False,"maneuver_completed":False,
        "termination_reason":"Saved original evidence assessment pending",
        "physical_failure_flags":[],"trace_reference":"trace.jsonl",
        "video_references":["overview.mkv","approach.mkv","reference_corner.mkv",
                            "driver_reference.mkv"],
        "video_frame_map_reference":"video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description":description,"recording_evidence":evidence,
        "realized_observables":{}}
    result = physical_result(attempt,result)
    validate_result(result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt",required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output",required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = build_report(args.attempt)
    result = saved_result(args.attempt,report)
    report["physical_checks"] = result["physical_checks"]
    report["realized_observables"] = result["realized_observables"]
    with (Path(args.attempt)/"result.json").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent, saved-only provenance and physical target audit."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from analysis import SOURCES, build_report


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def audit(attempt, *, diagnostic_test=False):
    root = Path(attempt)
    report = build_report(root)
    result = json.loads((root/"result.json").read_text())
    seal = json.loads((root/"capture-seal.json").read_text())
    provenance = json.loads((root/"acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    kind = "synthetic_fixture" if diagnostic_test else "native"
    marked = bool(diagnostic_test)
    if (seal.get("format") != "worker-sealed-capture" or
            seal.get("provenance_kind") != kind or
            seal.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not marked or
            seal.get("restoration",{}).get("restored") is not True or
            provenance.get("provenance_kind") != kind or
            provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not marked or
            (diagnostic_test and (result.get("provenance_kind") != kind or
                                  result.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not True))):
        raise ValueError("Native sealed capture and restoration proof required" if not diagnostic_test
                         else "Synthetic diagnostic seal and restoration proof required")
    if any(k in result for k in ("legal_verdict","compliant","violating")):
        raise ValueError("delivery result contains legal verdict")
    originals = (*SOURCES,"overview.mkv","approach.mkv","reference_corner.mkv",
                 "driver_reference.mkv")
    for name in originals:
        path = root/name
        if not path.is_file() or not path.stat().st_size:
            raise ValueError("missing original delivery source: "+name)
        digest = seal.get("sources",{}).get(name)
        if digest is None:
            raise ValueError("capture seal omits original source: "+name)
        # The pinned sealer's tree records a SHA digest for every original source.
        if isinstance(digest,str) and digest != sha(path):
            raise ValueError("sealed original source changed: "+name)
    observed = report["measurements"]["median_uturn_measurement"]["value"]
    config = json.loads((root/"config.json").read_text())
    if result.get("case_id") != config.get("selected_case_id"):
        raise ValueError("delivery result differs from exact case config")
    closed_approach = config["case"].get("physical_target") == "closed_divider_approach"
    wrong_roadway = config["case"].get("physical_target") == "non_right_roadway"
    no_turn = config["case"].get("physical_target") == "source_right_roadway_continuation"
    if result.get("measured_values") != observed:
        raise ValueError("result measurements differ from original saved geometry")
    targets = {item.get("target"):item for item in result.get("target_checks",[])}
    if no_turn:
        stayed = (observed["source_right_roadway_all_frames"] and
                  observed["source_right_roadway_final_occupancy"] and
                  not observed["opening_contact_frames"] and
                  not observed["closed_divider_contact_frames"] and
                  not observed["u_turn_orientation_observed"] and
                  not observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"])
        expected = (("source right roadway continued without turn",stayed),)
    elif wrong_roadway:
        reached_wrong = (observed["non_right_roadway_final_occupancy"] and
                         bool(observed["opening_full_body_frames"]) and
                         any(item["through_opening"] for item in
                             observed["roadway_centerline_crossings"]) and
                         not observed["closed_divider_contact_frames"] and
                         not observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"])
        expected = (("non-right roadway reached through opening",reached_wrong),
                    ("destination right roadway not reached",
                     observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"]))
    elif closed_approach:
        clearance = observed["final_closed_divider_clearance_m"]
        expected = (("closed-divider approach with full-body clearance",
                     not observed["opening_contact_frames"] and
                     not observed["closed_divider_contact_frames"] and
                     0 < clearance <= 1.0),
                    ("destination right roadway not reached",
                     observed["destination_right_roadway_departure_observed"]))
    else:
        expected = (("realized multiple-movement U-turn",observed["multiple_movement_observed"]),
                    ("full-body opening crossing without closed-divider contact",
                     observed["engineering_crossing_observed"]))
    for label, value in expected:
        if label not in targets or targets[label].get("measured") is not value:
            raise ValueError("physical target lacks matching saved evidence: "+label)
    required_states = (("behavior_attempted","maneuver_completed") if diagnostic_test else
                       ("setup_confirmed","behavior_attempted","maneuver_completed"))
    if not all(result.get(key) is True for key in required_states):
        raise ValueError("physical setup, attempt or maneuver not confirmed")
    if not all(item.get("matched") is True for item in targets.values()):
        raise ValueError("declared original physical target not matched")
    if no_turn:
        if not expected[0][1]:
            raise ValueError("original no-turn roadway continuation absent")
    elif wrong_roadway:
        if not expected[0][1] or expected[1][1]:
            raise ValueError("original non-right roadway occupancy absent")
    elif closed_approach:
        if (not expected[0][1] or expected[1][1] or
                observed["engineering_crossing_observed"]):
            raise ValueError("original safe closed-divider approach absent")
    elif not observed["engineering_crossing_observed"] or not observed["u_turn_orientation_observed"]:
        raise ValueError("original opening crossing or U-turn orientation absent")
    return {"delivery_physical_audit_passed":not diagnostic_test,
            "diagnostic_audit_test_passed":diagnostic_test,
            "legal_verdict_claimed":False,
            "source_hashes":{name:sha(root/name) for name in originals}}
